heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 285l–2 to 285l–5 of this title:

tree.heading: Alternative test method
tree.text: The term “alternative test method” means a test method that—

children.text: includes any new or revised test method; and
reduces the number of animals required;
refines procedures to lessen or eliminate pain or distress to animals, or enhances animal well-being; or
replaces animals with non-animal systems or one animal species with a phylogenetically lower animal species, such as replacing a mammal with an invertebrate.

tree.heading: ICCVAM test recommendation
tree.text: The term “ICCVAM test recommendation” means a summary report prepared by the ICCVAM characterizing the results of a scientific expert peer review of a test method.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the ICCVAM Authorization Act of 2000, and not as part of the Public Health Service Act which comprises this chapter.
